title: 银河小船
prompt:
Edit the provided image as a professional children's coloring-book illustrator. Maintain the established confident flowing black contours on pure white, playful organic shapes, and generous finger-coloring areas. No shading, gray, color, texture, text or watermark. Hard maximum20 white enclosed coloring regions across the whole picture, with no substantive tiny/narrow white compartments.

Simplify this into a cute expressive BOAT as the character: REMOVE the entire rabbit and scarf. Put two simple solid-black eyes and ONE curved closed-mouth smile on the large hull instead. Keep ONE large sail and ONE large star in empty white background. Replace the outlined white mast and top ball with ONE bold solid-black mast line, no ball. Remove the thin double-outline gunwale/upper rim and the narrow right-side hull stripe, leaving one broad simple curving hull silhouette with at most one broad bottom panel. No passengers, clothes, ropes or tiny white compartments.
previousPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Scene: A charming curving little boat carries ONE big-headed bunny sailor, leaning happily from the hull as if setting off on an imaginary night voyage. ONE large softly triangular sail and ONE large five-point star above; otherwise empty white background. Rabbit ears and hands broad and organic, no sailor stripes, no buttons, no rigging ropes crossing areas, no portholes, no waves or dense water patterns. Give the hull a graceful upward curl and the bunny an amusing eager pose. Use a single simple mast, not a network of fine sticks. Only 10–16 large enclosed colorable areas, strict max 20 including background.

Critical simplicity margin: plan only 8–12 broad enclosed regions so the finished drawing stays below 20. Every enclosed white patch must be roomy, at least about 60 pixels across at 1024 resolution. Draw mouths ONLY as one open black smile curve, never an outlined open mouth with a small white cavity. No white eye highlights, tiny cheek circles, little pompom compartments or double-outline slivers.
